verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API claims access to "the full breadth" of the platform, including Spend & Expense. The S&E API covers budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements, and webhooks deliver S&E events, so core S&E operations are programmable. However, nothing documents API-UI parity, and several UI-side features (custom approval policies, purchase requests/POs, AI coding) have no S&E API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or endpoint coverage map for S&E, API evidence for S&E approval policies and purchase workflows, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.
